payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_rebut.py::test_a_turn_that_raised_is_never_re_prompted_and_the_fix_turn_never_repeats stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/phases/rebut.py. The claim was "A turn that raised `implement.AgentFailed` is never re-prompted, and the fix turn runs once in every case. The witness drives each turn that can raise, with schema answers scripted after it. A failed fix turn makes one call. A failed first extraction makes two. A failed re-prompt makes three. Each keeps the raised error as its own, with the cost of every call it made. Only the re-prompt's failure sets `reprompt_error`.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_the_fast_gates_name_their_tool_and_pass_on_a_clean_tree[format], tests/test_session.py::test_rebut_records_each_blockers_answer_and_an_unread_turns_error, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
